# What are Binary Trees?

#### Course: DSA with C++

## What are Binary Trees?

A binary tree is a tree that has, at most, two children. Here's a simple example of a binary tree:

![Every node of a binary tree has a maximum of two children](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, each node has at most two children so the tree is a binary tree.
